international.summary: PM has asked Badenoch to withdraw her suggestion that benefits should be cut because ‘double amputees run marathons’ The government has no power to make Google take down a YouTube video with a message from Russell Brand from prison claiming he is innocent of his crimes, a minister has admitted. As Nadeem Badshah reports, the government has asked Google to take down the video. We don’t have any power to mandate a removal of content. That is up to Google. It’s based on their terms and conditions. But as I’ve been very clear, we’ve made a request in this instance because we feel very strongly that victims shouldn’t have to see this content.
